title: verifier.spec_frozen (v1)
description: EvaluatorAgent has finished preparing the verifier-first VerifierSpec and frozen it into the Research Store (see agents/evaluator_agent/data-contracts/verifier_spec.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the spec is read from the Research Store by ref. EvaluatorAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M7) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerifierSpec object.

verdict.description: EvaluatorAgent's verdict on the prepared VerifierSpec: fully specified (ok), missing pieces (incomplete), or unusable (invalid).
